VALUES.title: Learning through joy
VALUES.desc: We believe children learn best when they're having fun. Every game is designed to spark curiosity, not anxiety.

VALUES.title: Safe by design
VALUES.desc: No adverts, no in-app purchases, no social features. Just a clean, safe space for children to grow.

VALUES.title: Curriculum-aligned
VALUES.desc: Every activity maps to the UK National Curriculum for Key Stages 1 and 2, so parents and teachers can trust what children are learning.

VALUES.title: Built for families
VALUES.desc: From the Parent Hub to the Teacher Dashboard, Sodafom keeps the whole support network informed and involved.

VALUES.title: Adaptive difficulty
VALUES.desc: Games automatically adjust to each child's age and ability, keeping the challenge just right — never too easy, never overwhelming.

VALUES.title: Accessible to all
VALUES.desc: Dyslexia-friendly fonts, high-contrast mode, large text, and read-aloud support mean every child can participate.

MILESTONES.label: The idea is born
MILESTONES.desc: A parent frustrated by boring revision apps decides to build something better — a platform where learning feels like play.

MILESTONES.label: First 50 games launched
MILESTONES.desc: Sodafom goes live with 50 curriculum-aligned games across Maths, Spelling, and Reading. Early families love it.

MILESTONES.label: 100+ games & Teacher Hub
MILESTONES.desc: The platform grows to over 100 games. The Teacher Hub launches, bringing Sodafom into classrooms across the UK.

MILESTONES.label: Rewards and progress
MILESTONES.desc: The star reward system, badges, and parent progress dashboard are added to the platform.

TEAM.name: Dr Michael
TEAM.bio: A parent of two who built Sodafom after struggling to find engaging, safe, curriculum-aligned learning tools. Combines a background in education technology with a passion for making learning genuinely fun.

TEAM.name: The Community
TEAM.bio: Sodafom is shaped by the hundreds of parents and teachers who share feedback, suggest new games, and help us stay true to what children actually need. Every update is informed by real classroom experience.

PRESS.quote: A genuinely brilliant resource for primary-age children. The games are engaging, the progress tracking is superb, and there's not an advert in sight.
My Year 4 class uses Sodafom every Friday. The children ask for it — that's the highest praise I can give any EdTech tool.
Finally an app I'm happy to let my kids use unsupervised. Safe, educational, and they actually enjoy it.
